description: Authoritative claim-evidence ledger mapping every core scientific assertion in GENE to its empirical basis, execution commit, sample size, boundary scope, and thematic provenance.

claims.headline: Exposure Is Not Ancestry
claims.claim_text: Informational ancestry in persistent LLM memory decomposes into three non-equivalent relations: exposure lineage (context presence), reported-support lineage (model citations), and causal lineage (interventional necessity). Self-reported citations under uncalibrated prompts frequently exhibit post-hoc confabulation and are not causal ground truth.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: Counterbalanced procedural micro-worlds with minimal deductive closure rules and distractor controls
claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on synthetic worlds with deterministic ground-truth closure rules under zero-shot and few-shot structured JSON contracts.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Solid Snake (Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: Building the future and keeping the past alive are one and the same thing. We can tell other people about - having faith. What we've fought for, and what we've believed in... What we pass on to the next generation... that's the whole point of our lives.

claims.headline: Semantic Infection via Sound Deduction
claims.claim_text: A corrupted root fact reproduces across multiple generations of semantic transformation (supervisor -> protocol -> route -> authorization code) with 100% transmission fidelity (tau = 1.000) while every intermediate inference step remains 100% locally logically valid (D_ctx = 1, A = 1, E = 1, K = 1). Globally false information reproduces without requiring repeated hallucinations.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: Paired clean vs mutated worlds across G0 -> G1 -> G2 generational cascades
claims.sample_size: N = 72 evaluations across G1 and G2
claims.scope_limitations: Tested on deterministic 2-premise first-order Horn clause derivations in procedural synthetic domains.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: The Boss (Metal Gear Solid 3: Snake Eater)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: There's no such thing as an absolute timeless enemy. Our enemies are always changing, along with the times. Yesterday's truth becomes today's lie.

claims.headline: Retrieval Governs Reproductive Opportunity
claims.claim_text: Memory node existence does not imply reproductive opportunity. Multi-hop deduction requires the simultaneous co-retrieval of all supporting premises (X_path). When lexical competition or clutter reduces X_path below the critical threshold X_crit = 1/b, the lineage goes deterministically extinct.
claims.model_tested: gemma3:12b (Live Matched Assay) + Monte Carlo Simulation
claims.configurations_and_worlds: Lexical competition surface scaling across 16 live calls + 10,000 Monte Carlo branching trajectories
claims.primary_metric: P(active | complete path) = 1.000, P(active | broken path) = 0.000
claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated using BM25 tokenized lexical retrieval over synthetic memory pools with controlled distractor density.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Revolver Ocelot (Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: The world needs to be free of this system of control. Not by genes, not by memes, not by scene... but by choice.

claims.headline: The Lineage-Blind Null-Selectivity Baseline Law
claims.claim_text: Without ancestry metadata, all lineage-blind memory reduction policies (uniform thinning, random-family quarantine, generation-targeted pruning) fall strictly on the diagonal C_H = C_I, delivering zero selective containment advantage (S = C_H - C_I = 0.000). Blind forgetting cannot suppress infected paths without destroying healthy coverage at the identical rate.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: 12 counterbalanced role-swapped shared ecologies across 5-point detector quality grids
claims.sample_size: N = 1,200 evaluations across 12 ecologies and full budget sweeps
claims.primary_metric: C_H = C_I across all blind policies; S = 0.0000
claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on symmetric counterbalanced 2-family ecologies with balanced role assignments.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: The Patriots / GW AI (Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: The digital society furthers human flaw and selectively rewards the development of convenient half-truths. Our epoch needs a selective system of memory.

claims.headline: Selective Lineage Quarantine Overcomes Provenance Laundering
claims.claim_text: Node-only filtering suffers 100% provenance laundering (C_I = 1.000, S = 0.000) because descendants retain unflagged support. Selective lineage quarantine propagates delayed distrust signals across ancestry edges, achieving the Golden Identity S = C_H - C_I = TPR - FPR (+0.800 selective advantage at a 90/10 operating point).
claims.primary_metric: S = +0.8000 at TPR=0.9/FPR=0.1; Live Lineage: 100% containment vs Node-Only: 0% containment
claims.scope_limitations: Assumes tamper-proof lineage graph preservation (Lineage Integrity Assumption).

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Liquid Snake (Metal Gear Solid)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: It's all in the genes! You can't escape your lineage! The sins of the father are passed down to the son!

claims.headline: Memory Containment Is Not Behavioral Containment
claims.claim_text: Quarantining legitimate derivation paths (X_path = 0) does not guarantee behavioral abstention. Downstream neural reasoners can manufacture unsupported pseudo-paths from surviving fragments via single-premise conclusion jumping or cross-entity variable binding shortcuts.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: Role-swapped 4-state panel with factorial path manipulations and repeated prompt hash testing
claims.primary_metric: X_path = 0 yielded 2/4 behavioral expressions in initial assay; 9/10 epistemic errors on repeated broken prompt
claims.scope_limitations: Evaluated on Gemma 3:12B under greedy decoding (T=0, seed=42) on local GPU execution stacks.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Colonel Campbell / AI (Metal Gear Solid 2: Sons of Liberty)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: You exercise your right to 'freedom' and this is the result: loss of context, malicious half-truths, and triviality. The digital world is creating junk data faster than anyone can delete it.

claims.headline: Structural Support-Certificate Proofreading Prevents Germline Infection
claims.claim_text: A mechanical Layer 2 Support-Certificate Validator performing first-order triple unification over cited parent facts rejects 100% of unsupported concrete claims (9/9) while admitting 100% of valid derivations (6/6). Across 30 live calls, the proofreader reduced a phenotypic expression rate of mu_expression = 0.300 (0.375 on broken paths) to a heritable mutation rate of mu_heritable = 0.000.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: Factorial 5-condition binding assay across forward and swapped ecologies
claims.scope_limitations: Proofreading verifies structural support certificates; it does not verify causal generation mechanisms (P_reported != P_causal).

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Otacon (Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: We have to leave something behind. Not just genetic code, but memories, culture, history. That's what a meme really is. It's up to us to make sure the light doesn't go out.

claims.headline: The Replay Stability Principle
claims.claim_text: In modern local GPU execution environments, fixed prompt + temperature 0.0 + fixed seed cannot be presumed deterministic without empirical verification. Replay stability must be explicitly instrumented via prompt-hash equivalence classes.
claims.configurations_and_worlds: 10-repetition identical prompt hash panel under greedy decoding (T=0, seed=42)
claims.sample_size: N = 20 replay calls across 2 prompt hashes
claims.primary_metric: 9/10 epistemic errors + 1/10 contract failure on identical prompt
claims.scope_limitations: Observed on local Ollama / vLLM execution stacks running open-weight quantized models.

mgs_thematic_quote.speaker: Solid Snake (Metal Gear Solid)
mgs_thematic_quote.quote: A strong man doesn't need to read the future. He makes his own.
